organization_note: DeepSeek, which its Hugging Face card calls a Chinese company founded in 2023, develops the models; Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd. owns and operates the DeepSeek Open Platform, which provides the DeepSeek API under its own terms. It publishes weights and the DeepSeek Harness under its deepseek-ai organizations. One name, DeepSeek, covers the models, the API, and the products.

evidence.label: Open Platform terms: the DeepSeek Open Platform is owned and operated by Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.
